div.div: دَخِيلِىٌّ A gazelle [and any animal] brought up in, or near, the house or tent, and there fed, syn. رَبِيبٌ, (IAar, K, TA,) like أَهْلِىٌّ, (TA,) upon the neck of which are hung cowries. (IAar, TA.) And A horse that is fed only with fodder: so accord. to Aboo-Nasr and others: a meaning erroneously assigned in the K to ↓ دَخِيلٌ . (TA.) Accord. to Skr, A horse of a race called بَنَاتُ دَخِيلٍ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
